payload.core_mechanism_summary: Preprocess two 2D boolean grids using right-to-left and bottom-to-top DP to mark cells with clear eastern and southern views. Count cells where both are true.
payload.rationale: Solution fills row[i][j] and col[i][j] with recurrence relations indicating no rocks to the right or below, then counts cells with both true. This is a 2D DP state computation, matching dp_2d_state.
